name: Sasaguri (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Sasaguri town emblem in white: a stylised device of a winged top above an angular base.
history: Municipal flag of Sasaguri, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in November 1975.

features.role: Sasaguri town emblem — a stylised device of a winged top above an angular base
